name: research-skills-openai
description: Academic writing, editing, scientific research workflows, and independent review for the OpenAI ecosystem.

interface.shortDescription: Academic writing and reviewed research workflows
interface.longDescription: Write and edit clear academic and educational prose across disciplines, or develop research ideas, proposals, articles, Perspectives, and improvements to existing studies. Includes independent scientific review, methodology consultation, medical journal review, and statistical analysis planning. Uses the tools available in the OpenAI environment for general capabilities. An experimental personal project.
defaultPrompt: Write or edit clear, coherent academic and educational prose.
Develop research ideas, proposals, or manuscripts with independent scientific review.
Compare worthwhile improvements to an existing study and their costs.
